Subject: Consolidated response to Helio redlines — proposed next steps

Kira/Gina —

Thanks for sending the Helio redlines. Please find our consolidated responses attached. Short summary of our positions:
- Term: We can agree to a 24-month firm term. We have retained a single renewal clause with a 60-day opt-out window per Helio's ask; contracting team recommends keeping pricing fixed for the initial 12 months and opening a review window at month 12 for any materially changed usage patterns.
- Indemnity: Proposed language narrows third-party model carveouts to models Helio explicitly introduces or requests we integrate. We declined a broad carveout that would shift unbounded third-party liability to Redwood.
- Data retention & audit: We accept a 90-day export notice, and propose an Exhibit (attached) that outlines the export runbook and estimated operational lead time.
- Billing/proration & uplift: Exhibit B includes a proration formula and the 40% uplift line items — finance has confirmed the numbers.

Attachments: Redwood_Consolidated_Responses_v1.pdf; orderform_v3-exhibitB.xlsx
DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/signon/1234-helio-renewal

Request: Can Helio confirm if the positions above are acceptable and, if so, provide the procurement PO to attach to the DocuSign envelope? Our internal target is to finalize countersignature by 2027-07-08 to meet the onboarding timeline.

If you'd like a quick call to walk the language, happy to set one up for Monday.

Best,
Ben Carter
